options.label: Write a test for the last thing you built
options.description: Pick the single most critical behaviour you implemented in the last 5 prompts and write one test for it — the happy path only. A test written now is worth five written at the end.

options.label: Name the riskiest untested assumption
options.description: What is the one thing in your implementation that, if wrong, would cause the most user-visible damage? State it explicitly — then decide if it needs a test before you continue.

options.label: List the edge cases you haven't handled yet
options.description: Write a bulleted list of inputs or states your current implementation would handle incorrectly. Prioritise — which ones are worth a test before you ship?
